lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He holds the keys to the silent gate,
Beneath a moon of bone and slate,
Where shadows stretch and spirits tread,
Among the whispers of the dead.
[Pre-Chorus]
The river flows like ink of old,
In stories that the stones have told.
[Chorus]
Cross the tide where the lilies weep,
Into the hollows of the deep,
Where the silver mist begins to rise,
Underneath the weight of heavy skies.
[Verse]
He rows the wood with steady grace,
Across the lines of time and space,
Each passenger carries a secret name,
In a world of ash and frozen flame.
[Pre-Chorus]
The water sighs a hollow tune,
Beneath the ghost of a fading moon.
[Chorus]
Cross the tide where the lilies weep,
Into the hollows of the deep,
Where the silver mist begins to rise,
Underneath the weight of heavy skies.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The oarsmen's song is sharp and deep,
Secrets that the waking shadows keep.
[Chorus]
Cross the tide where the lilies weep,
Into the hollows of the deep,
Where the silver mist begins to rise,
Underneath the weight of heavy skies.
[Outro]
